name: 优雅简约
description: 源自 rico-md 的「优雅简约」主题（MIT, ricocc/rico-md）。

root.html: <section style="max-width: 100%; margin: 0 auto; padding: 20px 20px 48px 20px; font-family: Songti SC, Noto Serif SC, Georgia, serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 2; color: {{text}}; background-color: #fdfcfa; word-wrap: break-word; letter-spacing: 0.02em">{{content}}</section>

title.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 26px; font-weight: 400; color: {{heading}}; line-height: 1.5; margin: 48px 0 24px; text-align: center; letter-spacing: 0.12em; padding-bottom: 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e0ddd5">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

heading.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 20px; font-weight: 400; color: {{heading}}; line-height: 1.6; margin: 40px 0 20px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; padding-left: 16px; border-left: 2px solid #c4b8a0">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

heading3.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 17.5px; font-weight: 400; color: {{text}}; line-height: 1.65; margin: 32px 0 24px; letter-spacing: 0.04em">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

heading4.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: #4a4a4a; line-height: 1.65; margin: 28px 0 14px; letter-spacing: 0.03em">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

inlineCode.html: {{content}}

code.html: {{content}}

quote.html: {{content}}

link.html: {{content}}

tableHead.html: <th style="background-color: {{codeBg}}; padding: 12px 16px; text-align: left; border-bottom: 1px solid #c4b8a0; font-weight: 600; color: #4a4a4a; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.04em">{{content}}</th>

table.html: {{thead}}{{tbody}}

divider.html: <hr style="margin: 48px auto; border: none; height: 1px; background-color: #e0ddd5; max-width: 140px">
